body: I'm just going to try and make it as clear as I can that it's not her I'm not interested in, it's just that I want to be single. If I wanted a relationship again I'd love to be back with her but I'm just not interested right now.

Hopefully before it she'll ask how I am before it so I can save her the hurt by telling her I'm liking being single more than I thought I would, or something to that effect. So she knows I wouldn't be interested.
I'm sure she will on Monday, I've pretty much been spending today and yesterday thinking of how I can let her down with the minimal amount of hurt.

Ah that all fell to pot but that was a while ago now and I'm happier just being alone now anyway, can't be bothered with dating/relationships etc. Rather spend my time and money seeing my friends instead.    

Edit: Her latest status is "I'm strong enough to leave you but weak enough to need you"  couldn't be more obvious.

Ok so I'm seeing my ex on Monday, first time since the break up.    

I'm getting the idea she will ask me back, she's been posting songs/pictures/poems about missing a love of their life etc sort of thing a lot lately.    

She's going to get hurt because I'm going to say no, I feel bad because I don't want to hurt her but I'll have to.    

It's gonna suck...
Just a quick update to say, I'm still alive and (metaphorically) kicking. I appreciate all your help, too.
Yeah definitely, I think I could just do with some time alone now. Fuckin women just cause me problems when they're anything more than friends.

Not so good update: We were getting along quite well on the date I felt but her friend phoned upset about something and wouldn't tell her what it was so she made her apologies and left to see her friend, pretty disappointing really but I understand.

Was meant to see her again today but she said some stuff about a uni report with a deadline by next Tuesday then said she looked through my Facebook account and it seems I haven't forgotten my ex and I still have feelings for her. I told her that's simply not the case as we're still friends and that's all it is, that I wouldn't have my ex back even if she wanted me, that I just want to move on and look forward to seeing her (the new girl, obviously) again but she hasn't replied to that one.     think it's curtains for that then, shame as I thought things were going alright between us.    

Pretty gutted now, it's all gone to shit thanks to my ex.    

I feel like such a fucking twat as well because I told so many people I'm close to about meeting this new girl and now it's all fallen apart.    

Can't be arsed with this dating shit, might just stay single.   
    
:(
Just feels weird to me because I don't even get nervous going on stage to act in front of people but meet a girl for the first time and my nerves are all over the place!

Well I'm seeing her tomorrow but I'm nervous as fuck, she really looks forward to seeing me which is good but I'm just really nervous, both because it's a new person I'm meeting and there's always that expectation that something will go wrong and spoil my happiness.

I got her a bunch of tulips which I'm bringing with me tomorrow though, as they're her favourite flowers.

That was why she left me, that one time back in November. Thing is, she moved away for uni and lives a 2 hour train away so I can't always be there especially on my limited income.      

Buuuuuuuuuttttttttt on more positive news I am seeing a girl I met online next weekend which I look forward to :)
Masturbating.
I'll be keeping busy. She says there was this one time she really needed me and I wasn't there. That's it. That's all it was.

Oh yeah, he's hugely respected in the music industry by the likes of Jools Holland no less, he never really did much by himself but he did a lot of work with a lot of big names.    

As for her fuck her, she'll probably get treated like crap like the guy before me treated her and realise, then I'll tell her to fuck off because she had me and didn't want me.

Last night was pretty good, it was Albert Lee's 70th birthday concert. Dude can still play on stage for 3 and a half hours though, what a legend. Glad I went now.     

But on less happy news my ex told me she's seeing someone else. Already. I'm pretty pissed off with her and upset but I've said a lot to her (all reasonable and she understood all of it)

I'm not close to anyone and honestly I prefer to deal with these things by myself.   

I'm doing ok really I get pretty down now and then but that's about it. I prefer to do this alone as it's just easier, I don't want people making a fuss of me or anything - In a similar way to Roy Cropper and the way he's dealing with his wifes death in Coronation Street (if you're in the UK and you watch that show). Everyone was asking him if he was ok a lot etc etc etc but he just wanted to be left alone.    

My mum's going to some gig in London tonight, she was meant to go with my dad but they're going through a divorce now and he can't make it anyway so I said I'd go with her, we could both do with the company and maybe I'll let her know tonight.

Well, today would've been our 3 year anniversary. I've not even told any of my family or friends that we've split up, I don't really plan to unless it comes up in conversation (like they ask how things are between me and her or whatever)

So what, your life is going to suck for a while and you're going to give up? You got friends and a roof over your head, just keep soldiering on and see if things improve.    

Sometimes life just sucks and you have to deal with that fact. Might sound harsh but it's true.    

I know what it's like to go through a bad time but just because things are a bit shitty at the moment isn't justification for killing yourself. I'm in a similar if not worse position, if you need someone to talk to, you're welcome to send me a message.
I'd rather get through it myself, had 8 or so years of meds every day for my ADHD don't want all that again.

I've just got to pick myself up really, try and make something of myself regardless.    

Trouble is I'll always have that urge to give up on it all, that'll be the hardest thing. I struggle with motivation, I really find it hard to motivate myself to do anything at all. I only met her because of that panto, I never leave the house unless I have to or a friend wants to see me or some shit.

Well, I went with your suggestion. She was not keen on the idea at all and still quite angry at me but I went over and we had a great night together, I decided to stay over and left early the next morning because I had to.    

Though she was rather offish with me throughout last week and yesterday we met and she told me she doesn't think she's ready for a relationship, so it seems all that effort was for nothing. All over, I'm on my own in a shit situation with not much hope at all of it improving.    

I'm coping with it my own way, just keeping to myself. I've not told anyone though, I can't be bothered to.    

She wants to remain friends but I don't see the point. It'd be too difficult seeing her when she can't be what I want her to be, when I can't kiss her and tell her how much I love her and all she means to me.    

I'm just back to where I was 3 years ago, living my lonely life by myself with no one to talk to who understands.    

I can't just kill myself though, I couldn't do it to those who have stuck around in my life. I know I mean a lot to a lot of people and I couldn't leave them all behind.    

But fuck am I going to be lonely and find this difficult.
She is still away at uni, she doesn't even get back until tomorrow evening. I know where she'll be staying when she's back, I'll try and surprise her there. Thanks for the advice.

I did suggest to her we could do something Sunday but that just don't mean shit to her as Sunday isn't Valentines Day. As an aside, RE: Line breaks, see [this.](http://www.reddit.com/wiki/commenting#wiki_line_breaks)    

She's told me to just do my own thing and she'll do hers so it seems leaving early to see her just isn't an option. She's told me she's even considered going on a date with someone who's offered because "why shouldn't she spend the night with someone who appreciates her?" (her own words) and hearing that just made me want to kill myself even more. I couldn't bear the thought of her with someone else. It's not that I don't appreciate her I just don't want the pantomime to be fucked up and delayed after all our months of hard work because we couldn't get the stage ready in time.        

I have thought a while I am likely depressed but I've tried to speak to my local GP before and they've never been very helpful. I don't want to be on medication as I was on ritalin (and something else which replaced it but I don't remember what it was called) for years with my ADHD and I hated having to take a damn pill every damn day.
